Bar based power work for upper body

Perform 5 sets of 3 power pull-ups, resting 3 minutes between sets. 

Start each rep at the bottom of a pull-up (straight arms with shoulders engaged) and pull upwards as fast and explosively as possible. When you first start on this exercise, your chin may reach bar-level or very slightly above. With time, you will be able to extend the range of movement so that you’re able to have your chest level with the bar. Once you are able to go to this level with all 5 sets, add weight to slowly increase intensity. Do remember that speed and explosiveness are key for this session, so be cautious when adding weight as too much will reduce speed and explosivity.

Some climbers may wish to drop from the hanging position between each rep for 5 seconds or so to compose themselves for maximal power generation. This session should only be completed when well warmed up and not fatigued from other climbing or training exercises. 

Due to the amount of lateral force generated in the pulling motion, this workout should only be performed on a floor-mounted pull-up bar.
